Codex.title: 🏰 New Feature: Dungeon & Delve Generator Live on Codex Cryptica!
Codex.author: eserlan
Codex.text:
I'm excited to share that I just launched a brand new generator on the site: the Dungeon & Delve Generator!
👉 Try the standalone generator: https://codexcryptica.com/generators/dungeon-generator
You can use it as a quick standalone tool right on the site, or directly inside Codex Cryptica to generate location notes and automatically link dungeon nodes in your world vault.
Whether you need an ancient subterranean temple overrun by void-cultists, a black-budget orbital research facility with leaki
